transcript.text: Hi, yeah, my water heater is leaking all over the garage floor. Can someone come out today?

Sure. Is there anything I should be doing about the water in the meantime? It's spreading toward some boxes I have out here.
we can probably look at that

Wait, so is someone coming today? I still don't have an appointment or any idea what to do... okay, I guess I'll try someone else. Bye.
